templates.label: Job Bank for foreign candidates
templates.description: Official Government of Canada guidance for candidates outside Canada, with the entry point to jobs open to international candidates.
templates.notes: Page lists three steps (eligibility, credential recognition, job search). It states that applicants who have not yet applied for immigration or a work permit should start with IRCC.

templates.label: Jobs open to international candidates: {query}
templates.description: Job Bank search for this occupation title across Canada, filtered to postings the employer marked as open to international candidates.
templates.notes: fglo=1 is the filter used by the 'Search jobs open to international candidates' link on the foreign-candidates page. Employers decide whether to mark a posting; absence of the mark does not prove a job is closed to foreign applicants.

templates.label: Jobs open to international candidates by occupation group (NOC)
templates.description: Same filter, matched on the NOC 2021 unit group code (fn21) instead of a keyword.
templates.notes: fn21 takes the 5-digit NOC 2021 code. Verified with 72106 (welders).

templates.label: Jobs open to international candidates near {city}
templates.description: Keyword search in the selected city, filtered to postings open to international candidates.
templates.notes: Needs Job Bank's city id: pass locationparam={jbCityId} (from placeLocations in this file) and locationstring={city}. Without locationparam Job Bank silently ignores the location and searches all of Canada. The search covers the city and nearby communities (a default radius).

templates.label: All current postings near {city}
templates.description: Keyword search in the selected city, all postings (including those limited to people already allowed to work in Canada).
templates.notes: Needs Job Bank's city id: pass locationparam={jbCityId} (from placeLocations in this file) and locationstring={city}. Without locationparam Job Bank silently ignores the location and searches all of Canada. The search covers the city and nearby communities (a default radius). Includes postings for Canadians, permanent residents and work-permit holders only.

templates.label: Postings in this occupation group near {city}
templates.description: NOC 2021 unit group search in the selected city (all postings).
templates.notes: Needs Job Bank's city id: pass locationparam={jbCityId} (from placeLocations in this file) and locationstring={city}. Without locationparam Job Bank silently ignores the location and searches all of Canada. The search covers the city and nearby communities (a default radius).

feedStatus.explanation: Job Bank's Terms of use - Job seekers (https://www.jobbank.gc.ca/termsofuseseeker) prohibit scripts, robots, crawlers, screen scrapers and other automated query programs, and no public API for current postings was found. The app therefore links to Job Bank searches and does not fetch or display live postings. Job Bank publishes a monthly open-data CSV of postings (open.canada.ca dataset ea639e28-c0fc-48bf-b5dd-b8899bd43072, Open Government Licence - Canada); it is historical (previous month) and must never be described as currently open.
